concern: Urdu بجز ("except") is romanised "Bajz", dropping the short vowel entirely. The same word appears 22 times elsewhere in the corpus as "bajuz" (e.g. surahs 22, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 34, 37, 38, 40, 43, 46, 53, 57) versus only 6 as "bajz" (11, 16x2, 19, 21). This is a vowel omission, not an R1 long-vowel doubling choice (canonical.tsv has no row for it).
suggestion: Bajuz un ke jo tauba kar len aur imaan laayen aur nek amal karen, aise log jannat mein jaayenge aur un ki zara si bhi haq-talfi na ki jaayegi.

concern: Urdu مطلع ("informed/aware of the unseen") is romanised "muttale", but it is pronounced muttali (ends -li). The owner already corrected the identical word at 72:26 from "muttale" to "muttali" (Q18, fidelity-findings.tsv row 39). That fix was applied only to 72:26 and this occurrence still has the old spelling.
suggestion: Kya woh ghaib par muttali hai ya Allah ka koi wada le chuka hai?
